# CuTe/mctlass headers for C500 Triangle Attention

This directory contains the 82 headers from the compiler dependency graph used
by the C500 Triangle Attention kernels. The native build uses this repository-local
snapshot through `build.sh`.

The source snapshot was taken from `fdy_tri_attn` revision
`4bb57aec005da0331ba9b22529f844884137684b`. Its `extended_mctlass` subtree was
unchanged from revision `3ccb096583a50e964744dc19d16d5c59c3167185`.

Each copied header retains its original NVIDIA copyright and BSD-3-Clause
redistribution notice. See `LICENSE`.
